detail: ops/injection_lint.py:32 resolves KG_INJECTION_BASELINE (and VIEWS_ROOT at :31) against the CALLER'S CWD, while docs/reference/tech_index.md:188 states in writing that the variable is resolved against the repo root and that parent and child processes therefore agree. One of the two is wrong today. ops/backlog.py had the identical line and was fixed on 2026-08-07 to ROOT-anchor it — measured consequence there: standing in a directory holding a superset baseline made the closed-without-verification ratchet print '0 problems' rc=0 while forgiving every id. injection_lint's baseline feeds a cutover block gate and a pre-commit hook, both of which inherit the caller's environment, so the same disarm shape is available; ui_quality_gate.py reads the same variable and already hard-refuses an unreadable path, which makes a split between the two readers observable as a bare rc rather than as a message.
source: code review of the backlog cwd fix
